Ram Temple Trust addresses donation concerns amid allegations

The Ram Temple Trust has stated that over 30 kg of gold and 1.5 tonnes of silver have been accounted for, following allegations of irregularities in donation handling. Champat Rai, a senior official, has called the accusations baseless and stated he will respond after an SIT report. The Allahabad High Court has declined to entertain a Public Interest Litigation seeking a CBI probe into the matter.
